n07aebf423d.headline: Applicants waited a year for ministry decision on subsidy allocation, found NKÚ | Aktuálně.cz
n07aebf423d.summary: Applicants waited a year for decisions on subsidy allocations from the Operational Programme Enterprise and Innovation for Competitiveness (OP PIK), impacting small and medium enterprises, large companies, and research bodies.
n07aebf423d.why: Subsidies are critical for innovation and growth in SMEs and research sectors, affecting economic development and business investment in the Czech Republic.
